answer: We design a Sybil-resistant mechanism using zero-knowledge verifiable delay and dynamic opportunity-cost bonds, requiring nodes to lock staking collateral protected by a cipher. Capital barrier analysis confirms a subgame-perfect slashing matrix across an adversarial basalt network forces identity multiplication payoff strictly negative via instant slashing penalties. Consequently, rational agents in this decentralized grove converge to a robust Nash equilibrium, since asymmetric penalties preclude profitable deviations, rendering Sybil attacks suboptimal.
